reason: QA Lead forwarded root clarification of existing AC08/09/10: same-guide delayed supplementation must update current provenance without replaying primary speech or mutating original transmission.
contractBinding: Use canonical monotonically increasing snapshotRevision when Tech contract is frozen; preserve guidanceId and guidanceVersion. Field naming adapter cannot change identity semantics.

cases.name: same-guidance-delayed-supplement

precondition.firstTransmission: captured immutable full primary payload with initial empty supplement/evidence

injection.delay: finish actual valid provider response after primary display/speech start and before 5000ms deadline
injection.publication: augment current guide via snapshotRevision R+1; guidanceId/version unchanged
injection.repeat: deliver duplicate enrichment publication and reconnect snapshot

expected.currentEvidence: actual selected document/version/chunk and rag_run link
expected.firstTransmissionPayload: byte/content hash unchanged including original wording, route, locale and original supplement/evidence fields
expected.primaryBeeps: no additional beep caused by supplement, duplicate publication, or reconnect
expected.urgentAudio: retains priority; new urgent primary cancels or outranks any lower-priority supplemental speech
expected.staleSupplement: discarded if guidance identity/freshness changes before acceptance

requiredEvidence: Before/after DB and snapshot records with first/current content hashes
SSE envelope identity and increasing snapshot revision
Android display/audio/vibration event timestamps plus actual audible execution evidence linked to same IDs
Authorized administrator view of immutable first transmission versus augmented current guide
cases.note: Deterministic mock can verify envelope/reducer control flow, but actual provider and physical Android execution are separately mandatory for this integrated variant.
